### Data Visualization & Insights | R Programming | Clinical Trial Risk Analytics

<hr> 

### About Me

I share data visualizations built for weekly community challenges — TidyTuesday, MakeoverMonday, and SWD Challenge — along with the R code behind them, and the occasional lesson learned along the way.

I am a Senior Manager in the Clinical Trial Risk Management group at Bristol Myers Squibb, NJ, USA.

<hr>

### Interests

* Weekly data visualization practice — TidyTuesday, MakeoverMonday, SWD Challenge
* R & the tidyverse / ggplot2 ecosystem
* Data storytelling and visual communication
* Clinical trial risk analytics & signal detection
